name_reason: Conforms to data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> with the battle core-table prefix (battle pathfinding is a battle subsystem). The _ptr suffix correctly reflects the pointer datatype, and tile_cost_table accurately names its role: the base of the primary tile-attribute -> movement-cost lookup table, dereferenced by both leaf neighbor-step routines as base[(attr & 0x3FF)*4 + 1]. No Ghidra address residue in the name. Adding 'primary' would be cosmetic churn across protos.h/globals.h/4 call sites for negligible clarity gain; the source/plate comments already note 'primary'.
purpose: Runtime pointer to the caller-supplied primary tile-attribute -> movement-cost lookup table, used by the battle pathfind/flood-fill leaves to map a tile's attribute word to a secondary-cost-table index.
logic_summary: 32-bit BSS pointer @ 0x60060 (.object3). Written by both pathfind orchestrators at entry from their `af` argument (MOV [0x60060],EAX at 0x4E081 in fd2_init_movement_range_floodfill and 0x4E207 in fd2_pathfind_to_destination). Read by the two leaf neighbor-step routines (fd2_flood_fill_neighbor_step @ 0x4E17B, fd2_pathfind_neighbor_step_with_tiebreak @ 0x4E33D) as a (uint8 *) base: secondary_index = base[(attr & 0x3FF)*4 + 1] (binary AND AH,3; SHL AX,2; ADD EAX,[0x60060]; INC EAX; MOV CH,[EAX]). That secondary index then selects the tile's movement cost from the SEPARATE secondary cost table whose base lives in data_fd2_battle_pathfind_caller_context (0x6006A). Write-before-read: orchestrators set it before any reader runs, so the BSS load value (zero) is never observed.
element_semantics: Single scalar pointer (not an array): base address of the primary tile-attribute -> cost lookup table. Each primary-table entry is 4 bytes; readers index it at byte offset (attr & 0x3FF)*4 + 1 to read one secondary-table index byte.
comment_original_issue: Source comment said the value is 'passed as pCost_table', a parameter name that does not exist in the emitted orchestrators (the actual argument is `af`); it also did not make explicit that this is the PRIMARY table while the secondary cost table base lives in data_fd2_battle_pathfind_caller_context, nor that the game only writes (never reads) it -> non-const.
notes: Plate was <null> before (no existing data plate); created a concise PLATE_COMMENT via run_script_inline reflecting the src conclusion and saved the program (save_program success). Cross-checked both readers' disassembly (0x4E16E, 0x4E330) and both writers' bytes (0x4E081, 0x4E207 = MOV [0x60060],EAX, opcode a3 60 00 06 00) plus the orchestrator setup at 0x4E040. Memory at 0x60060 is all-zero (BSS), consistent with runtime population. The script-compiler noise in run_script_inline output is from unrelated stale files in the ghidra_scripts folder; my scripts ran and succeeded (CU_CLASS=DataDB, PLATE_SET_OK).
